mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s take a moment to really let this sink in. Walking forward in communion with Christ isn’t about having all the answers or following some perfect formula. It’s a living, breathing relationship—one that shifts and grows as you do. You’ll experience seasons of joy, and yes, times when things feel dry or confusing. Sometimes you’ll feel strong, other times not so much. But through it all, the invitation is simple: draw near, be honest, and trust that Christ is right there with you, working in ways you may not always see. What are the big takeaways here? Well, it’s those small, everyday moments of openness that make room for Christ’s presence to grow in your life. The Holy Spirit often nudges you gently—so gently, it’s easy to miss if you’re not paying attention. Sticking with those ordinary routines? That’s what shapes a life of deep, lasting connection. And don’t let suffering or doubt make you think you’re off track. Those experiences are actually invitations—opportunities to trust and let go, even deeper than before. And here’s something you can’t forget: you’re not meant to do this alone. Community matters. Faith grows best when it’s shared, not when you try to carry it all by yourself. If you find yourself longing for more, you’re in good company. The path is wide open to you—no matter your past, no matter your doubts. You don’t need perfect circumstances, and you definitely don’t need to have it all figured out. Just start where you are, with what you have, and trust that Christ will meet you right there. This journey isn’t about striving or achieving—it’s about receiving, again and again, the love and presence of the One who knows you fully and loves you completely. So, as you move forward, remember: every single step, no matter how small, takes you deeper into the heart of Christ. Let that give you courage, hope, and a quiet confidence for whatever comes next. Just keep walking—one day at a time.
